tasks.name: 剧情总结提示词后处理
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
(async () => {
    const mod = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/generate/llm.js');
    const before = mod.isMergePrefillIntoUserEnabled();
    const after = mod.toggleMergePrefillIntoUser();
    window.toastr?.success(`剧情总结提示词后处理：${before ? '开' : '关'} → ${after ? '开' : '关'}`);
})();
<</taskjs>>
